skill_name: Explain how algorithms can be biased.
workflow: Algorithms can be biased if they are trained and tested on data sets that do not represent the full diversity of the population or that contain built-in biases and assumptions. Additionally, algorithms can become biased if they are trained on data sets containing irrelevant or harmful variables that contribute to inaccurate or unfair outputs.
